task: Fix skill import ZIP bundle HTTP 400 error display to show backend message/details in toast instead of generic HTTP error string.

key_reasoning.reason: Two components touched: skills.ts store action (primary fix — detect HttpError, await response.json(), call api.handleError) and CreateSkillPopup.tsx component (secondary cleanup — remove violating component-level toaster.error call). Change is additive within one feature flow.

Fix follows established patterns (api.handleError, instanceof HttpError, Valtio async actions). One careful implementation point: Response.json() is async and single-consume inside a catch block — requires defensive handling for already-consumed body and non-JSON responses. Risk is concrete and manageable, not novel.
